newsitem.title: UK: Universal Salvage sees profit below forecast.
newsitem.headline: Universal Salvage sees profit below forecast.

text.p: Britain's Universal Salvage Plc said on Monday its pre-tax profit for the year ending April 30 would be substantially below current market expectations.
The company also said its managing director, Richard Bird, had left the company.
Chairman Cliff Bassett will assume the role of managing director until a successor to Bird is appointed, the company said in a statement.
Universal, which manages the disposal of cars that have been declared write-offs, said profits in the final quarter had been significantly lower than expected.
"Significant start-up costs have been incurred to prepare for recently-awarded salvage contracts which will benefit profitability in the next financial year," the firm said.
Universal's shares were marked down 65p at 137.5 by 1005 GMT.
